items.title_en: 4 THINGS TO DO TO FALL ASLEEP
items.title_cn: 4 THINGS TO DO TO FALL ASLEEP
items.desc_en:
Sleep is the foundation of mental health, physical health, and performance. Each of us has different sleep needs but most need between 6-9 hours.

The longer we are awake, the more adenosine builds up in our body and brain. Adenosine promote sleepiness.

Many things inhibit our ability to fall asleep. Caffeine too close to bedtime, room too hot, gnawing hunger, worry etc.

This video explains 4 key things that promote falling asleep. These are things you can control.

1) Core body temperature needs to drop.

items.title_en: Essentials: How to Learn Better & Create Your Best Future | Tim Ferriss
items.title_cn: Essentials: How to Learn Better & Create Your Best Future | Tim Ferriss
items.desc_en:
In this episode of ⁠Huberman Lab Essentials⁠, my guest is Tim Ferriss, a bestselling ⁠author⁠, technology investor, and host of ⁠The Tim Ferriss Show⁠ podcast. We discuss Tim’s approach to exploration, self-experimentation, and mastery, as well as his own experiences with depression, suicidal thoughts, and childhood trauma. We also explore practical strategies to build meaningful professional relationships, find mentors, and prioritize personal and professional growth.

Show notes: https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/essentials-how-to-learn-better-and-create-your-best-future-tim-ferriss
